description:
⚠️ WRITE OPERATION - Confirm with user before calling. Dismisses active warnings for a connection. If `warning_types` is provided, only the provided types are dismissed.
If `warning_types` is omitted or empty, all active warnings for the connection are dismissed.

Validation is performed before any warnings are dismissed. If any value in `warning_types` is unrecognized or null,
the entire request is rejected with 400 and no warnings are dismissed.

Dismissed warnings may reappear on the next sync if the underlying issue is not resolved.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the connection. Retrieve it from the `id` field in the [List All Connections](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/list-connections) response, or from the `id` field returned when you [Create a Connection](https://fivetran.com/docs/rest-api/api-reference/connections/create-connection).

warning_types.description: List of warning type codes to dismiss. Use the `type` field from `GET /v1/connections/{connectionId}/warnings` to get valid values. Values are case-sensitive strings. If omitted or empty, all active warnings are dismissed.
